questions.q: A single check can be applied against how many open transactions?
options: Exactly one, always
Only transactions dated in the current month
One or more, as long as the applied amounts are confirmed for each
Only miscellaneous cash transactions
questions.explain: One receipt can be applied across multiple open transactions in a single Apply Receipts action, with Receivables tracking the amount applied to each.

questions.q: What happens by default when a customer pays less than the full balance due (a short pay)?
options: The entire invoice is automatically written off
The receipt is rejected and cannot be entered
The available amount is applied and the remaining balance stays open
Receivables automatically refunds the receipt
questions.explain: A short pay applies the amount that is available, leaving the remaining balance open unless a small residual is written off per company policy.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the standard options for handling an overpayment?
options: Leave the excess unapplied on the receipt
Apply the excess on-account to the customer
Refund the excess back to the customer
Automatically transfer the excess to a different customer's account
questions.explain: Overpayments are left unapplied, applied on-account, or refunded — they are never automatically moved to a different customer's account.

questions.q: What does 'unapplying' a receipt from a transaction do?
options: Permanently deletes the receipt from the system
Reverses the application, restoring the transaction's balance due and freeing the receipt amount
Automatically writes off the transaction
Converts the receipt into a miscellaneous receipt
questions.explain: Unapplying reverses a receipt application, returning the transaction's balance due and making the receipt amount available to apply elsewhere.

questions.q: At what level does a receipt application normally reduce a transaction's balance?
options: At the individual tax line only
At the freight line only
At the transaction level, reducing the overall balance due
At the General Ledger account level directly
questions.explain: Receipt applications normally happen at the transaction level, which is what drives whether an invoice shows as open, partially paid, or closed.
